result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major missing image in the 'Popular right now' section, and one minor text truncation issue in the restaurant listing.

issues.description: The first card in the 'Popular right now' section (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) is showing a broken/missing image placeholder (grey box with an image icon crossed out) instead of an actual restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image URL for Tokumaru Ramen Bar is valid and accessible. Implement a proper fallback image if the original fails to load, rather than showing a broken image icon.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated (cut off) due to insufficient width, likely missing the last letters of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Either reduce font size, allow text wrapping, use an ellipsis with tooltip, or widen the card to accommodate the full restaurant name.
